world.b: An explosion hit Yemen's capital as Houthi missiles were intercepted over Riyadh. Follow Al Jazeera's live coverage of the US-Israel war on Iran.
world.title: Iran denies carrying out drone attack that killed two Italians in Kuwait

world.h: Strike on Saudi Jazan refinery kills worker
world.b: Saudi Arabia said a projectile hit the Red Sea refinery, starting a fire; the Saudi-led coalition blamed Yemen's Houthis.
world.title: Attack on Saudi’s Jazan refinery kills one person, disrupts operations

world.h: Egypt detains driver over Cairo tanker fire that killed 31
world.b: Prosecutors ordered a 21-year-old held over the ring-road collision that overturned a fuel tanker, and sent him for drug tests.
world.title: Egypt detains driver over Cairo fuel tanker fire that killed 31

world.h: DR Congo Ebola cases pass 12,000 as fighting disrupts response
world.b: Response workers have been forced out of affected areas as clashes intensify in eastern Congo's Ituri province, officials said.

world.h: Kim calls for wider deployment of tactical nukes
world.b: North Korea's leader said tactical nuclear weapons should be deployed 'across multiple domains' as he inspected nuclear material production sites, state media said.

world.h: Ukraine says it hit five planes at Russian air base
world.b: Ukraine's General Staff said it struck the Savasleyka airbase east of Moscow, damaging three MiG-31s and two Su-34s.

national.h: Report: CIA waterboarded more people than it admitted
national.b: The New York Times reported the finding after suing for material gathered by special prosecutor John Durham; the CIA had admitted waterboarding three people.
national.title: Report: CIA tortured more people with waterboarding than US agency admitted

national.h: Judge strikes down Trump's birthright citizenship limits
national.b: Judge Christopher Cooper ruled that the US-born children the administration targeted are under US jurisdiction and guaranteed citizenship.
national.title: Judge strikes down Trump’s latest restrictions on US birthright citizenship

national.h: King tides and waves destroy part of Pacifica pier
national.b: A massive wave tore down a section of the already-closed Northern California pier as beachfront homes began flooding.

national.h: Rain, wind and flooding hit much of US on Thanksgiving
national.b: An East Coast storm postponed Macy's 100th parade to Saturday, while king tides brought flood warnings out West.

national.h: Judge blocks FCC review of ABC station licenses
national.b: Judge Loren AliKhan found the FCC's early review of Disney's ABC licenses was unconstitutional retaliation for coverage Trump dislikes.
national.title: U.S. Judge rules FCC violated ABC's free speech rights to please Trump

national.h: Plane crash off Mississippi kills Florida family of 6
national.b: The small plane was returning from a fishing trip when it crashed Tuesday; pilot Brent Stokes, 50, was among the dead, the coroner said.

politics.h: Judge won't extend ban on pro-Trump government ads
politics.b: Judge Loren AliKhan declined Democrats' request for a long-term ban on taxpayer-funded TV spots they called propaganda.
politics.title: Judge declines to issue a long-term ban on taxpayer-funded, pro-Trump ads critics called propaganda

politics.h: Trump calls GDP figures 'fake,' seeks investigation
politics.b: He accused the Commerce Department of issuing incorrect growth figures before the midterms, after it revised third-quarter GDP up to 4.3%.

politics.h: Trump open to meeting El-Sayed on Medicare for All
politics.b: Weeks after attacking him on the campaign trail, Trump says he will meet the incoming Democratic senator to discuss a national healthcare program.

international.h: Winter rains force displaced Gazans to flee again
international.b: About 1.36 million Palestinians, 65% of Gaza's population, live in tents and makeshift shelters that flood in heavy rain, the UN says.
international.title: Why are winter rains forcing Palestinians in Gaza to flee again?

international.h: Mexico seeks US talks over suspected SpaceX debris
international.b: Mexico wants a meeting on use of its airspace and possibly relocating the launch site after recovering debris from a Starship launch.
international.title: Mexico seeks US talks about suspected SpaceX debris

international.h: Ukrainian drone strike kills five in occupied Zaporizhia
international.b: A Russian-installed governor said the drone hit a parking lot in Vesioloye, as Russia launched a ballistic missile attack on Kyiv.

international.h: Explosion at Bangkok oil refinery injures seven
international.b: Bangchak shut all production units at its Phra Khanong refinery after the blaze, and nearby residents were urged to evacuate.

international.h: Kenyan court faults US-backed Ebola quarantine site
international.b: A High Court judge ruled the government breached the constitution by not disclosing the deal or seeking public input on the facility near Nanyuki.

international.h: Israeli attacks kill eight in Gaza, including education official
international.b: Health officials said a senior education official and his wife were among those killed despite the ceasefire.

international.h: Iraq denies troops moving toward Kurdish region
international.b: A government spokesperson called the reports untrue as Baghdad presses its claim over Kurdish border crossings and oil, citing smuggling.

international.h: Puerto Rico's top court ends Luma Energy contract
international.b: In a tight vote, the Supreme Court sided with the government's bid to cancel the private power company's contract after years of outages.

international.h: Indonesia gold mine flood kills at least 13
international.b: Thirteen more workers remain missing after flooding hit an unauthorised gold mine in West Java's Bogor district, rescuers said.

international.h: ISIL suicide attack kills two Syrian security officers
international.b: Four gunmen attacked a checkpoint in Hasakah on Wednesday, killing two security personnel and wounding five; all four attackers died.

business.h: Oil glut possible despite wars and high prices
business.b: IEA figures show global oil supply surpassing demand this quarter, a trend likely to continue in 2027.
business.title: Despite market disruptions, is an oil glut on the way?

business.h: 'Kidults' drive a 20% jump in toy sales
business.b: Adults buying board games, building sets and trading cards helped push toy sales up 20% from January through September.
business.title: 'Kidults' are driving toy sales this year

business.h: Musk pledges two SpaceX shares for every US child
business.b: The giveaway, worth about $18 billion, came hours after SpaceX won approval to deploy 1 million satellites for space data centers.
business.title: Musk pledges two SpaceX shares for every US child

business.h: South Korea raises interest rates amid chip boom
business.b: The Bank of Korea lifted its key rate a quarter point to 3.25%, citing strong growth driven by AI chip demand and above-target inflation.

business.h: Amodei denies wanting humans to cede control to AI
business.b: In a post on X, the Anthropic CEO said he does not support surrendering 'human free will' to AI and that the technology should be subject to democratic processes.

science.b: These highest tides of the year come when the sun, moon and Earth nearly align, and this year's super El Niño has pushed coastal water levels higher.
science.title: What are king tides? These exceptionally high tides are increasingly flooding coastal communities

science.h: Scientists wary of SpaceX's 1 million-satellite plan
science.b: The FCC's approval of SpaceX's Starmind data center constellation has raised skepticism and alarm among some scientists.
science.title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical

sports.h: Steelers cut Aaron Rodgers after he rips coach on TV
sports.b: Pittsburgh released the 42-year-old four-time MVP Wednesday after he criticized Mike McCarthy on 'The Pat McAfee Show' following his benching.

sports.h: Senegal gets Africa Cup title back
sports.b: The Court of Arbitration for Sport overturned a ruling that had handed the Africa Cup of Nations trophy to Morocco after Senegal's players walked off.

goodnews.h: Coonhound Rocker wins National Dog Show
goodnews.b: The black and tan coonhound took best in show over six other group winners.
goodnews.title: Black and tan coonhound Rocker is top dog at the 2026 National Dog Show

local.h: Albany to welcome 27 new Assembly Democrats
local.b: Democrats will hold at least 158 of the Legislature's 213 seats in January, which could decide the fate of long-stalled bills.
local.title: Fate of long-stalled NY bills could be decided by 27 new Democrats

local.h: NJ Turnpike Authority eyes housing near interchanges
local.b: The plan would develop five tracts it owns near Turnpike and Parkway interchanges, advancing Gov. Sherrill's housing goals.
local.title: NJ agency eyes housing along the highways in Central Jersey

local.h: Storm's worst hits NYC Thanksgiving evening
local.b: Forecasters expect the heaviest rain and winds up to 65 mph from about 4 to 10 p.m., and Mayor Mamdani urged travelers to allow extra time.
local.title: Travel treachery: The Thanksgiving holiday travel outlook is grim

local.h: State boosts sobriety checkpoints for Thanksgiving weekend
local.b: Gov. Hochul announced extra patrols through Sunday targeting drunk and reckless drivers.
local.title: New York State and local police out at sobriety checkpoints all Thanksgiving weekend long

local.h: Bill would let crash victims track NYPD investigations online
local.b: A City Council proposal would require a secure site showing case status, summonses, arrests and witnesses for victims of serious crashes.
local.title: NYC bill would give crash victims online access to NYPD investigation updates

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: Rain, mainly before 1am. The rain could be heavy at times.  Temperature rising to around 59 by 11pm. Windy, with a northeast wind 23 to 33 mph becoming southeast 13 to 23 mph after midnight. Winds could gust as high as 55 mph.  Chance of precipitation is 100%. New precipitation amounts between a half and three quarters of an inch possible.

periods.name: Friday
periods.text: A slight chance of rain before 1pm, then a chance of showers between 1pm and 4pm.  Mostly cloudy, with a temperature falling to around 51 by 4pm. Breezy, with a southwest wind 16 to 20 mph.  Chance of precipitation is 40%.

periods.name: Friday Night
periods.text: Mostly cloudy, with a steady temperature around 52. West wind around 18 mph.

periods.name: Saturday
periods.text: Partly sunny, with a high near 55. West wind 15 to 17 mph.

periods.name: Saturday Night
periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 46. West wind 10 to 14 mph.

periods.name: Sunday
periods.text: Mostly sunny, with a high near 57.

localgood.h: Astoria the wild turkey charms Battery Park
localgood.b: The turkey, first spotted in her namesake Queens neighborhood, has become a beloved sight in Lower Manhattan.
localgood.title: Every day is Turkey Day in Battery Park for fans of Astoria the bird
